title: Ghost Boys
author: Jewel Parker Rhodes
current_text: Ghost Boys was formally challenged in Humble ISD in September 2020 because the complainant said it included “negative stereotypes aimed at police”; a review committee found it appropriate. The Kingsburg (CA) Elementary Charter School District removed Ghost Boys from its curriculum after a parent complained about its political views, without going through a reconsideration process.

sources.quote: "Ghost Boys" by Jewell Parker Rhodes: formally challenged in September 2020 in Humble ISD because the complainant said it included “negative stereotypes aimed at police.” A review committee found it was appropriate.
sources.title: Complaints: Books challenged in Houston schools are 'contrary to everything Christian', promote BLM

sources.quote: The Kingsburg (CA) Elementary Charter School District removed this book from its curriculum after a parent complained about the political views expressed in the book. The novel concerns a Black boy who is killed by police while playing with a toy gun. The district removed the book without going through a reconsideration process.
